steps.title: Configure App Metadata
steps.description: Establish the application package name com.studentassistant.app and user-friendly title Student Assistant.

steps.title: Establish Build Script
steps.description: Configure the app level build.gradle script with correct SDK values, dependencies, and Java 8 compilation standards.

steps.title: Formulate Android Manifest
steps.description: Create AndroidManifest.xml defining package structure, application launcher activity, and custom drawable launcher icon.

steps.title: Design Dashboard UI
steps.description: Build layout file containing vertical flow elements, modular cards for Pomodoro timer, tasks tracking, GPA logs, and simple study notes.

steps.title: Set up Main Activity Structure
steps.description: Declare components, views, arrays, state parameters, and click handlers inside MainActivity.java.

steps.title: Integrate Dynamic Navigation
steps.description: Design dynamic listener configurations to toggle between homework layouts, GPA logs, timer view, and notes board with visual updates on selected tabs.

steps.title: Code Assignment Tracker System
steps.description: Create dynamic inputs, priority dropdown adapters, and list displays. Save task statuses to local SharedPreferences.

steps.title: Develop Academic GPA Calculator
steps.description: Assemble logic to add individual courses with credit weights, map letter grades to grade points, and compute global GPA dynamically.

steps.title: Implement Pomodoro Study Timer
steps.description: Construct CountDownTimer routines supporting configurable modes (25-min Study block, 5-min Short break, 15-min Long break).

steps.title: Implement Auto-saving Study Note Pad
steps.description: Develop TextWatcher functionality on the multi-line notepad text viewer to auto-persist updates to SharedPreferences.

steps.title: Ensure Compatibility Constraints
steps.description: Verify Java compatibility with standard system classes and SDK 34 targets without modern framework overhead.

steps.title: Building Student Assistant
steps.description: Perform build checks and construct the output application package debug binary.
